title: Design System: NextShow User App
scope: apps/user_app — Discovery surface + shared navigation (Marquee After Dark redesign)

display-xl.purpose: Spotlight title only; steps to 34px past ~20 chars.

mono.purpose: Every label, tag, metadata run, nav label — uppercase.

mono-tiny.purpose: Location strip, page counters, poster sub-labels.

shadows.name: dock-lift-ambient
shadows.purpose: Wide soft shadow under the floating nav dock.

shadows.name: dock-lift-contact
shadows.purpose: Tight contact shadow, paired with the ambient.

shadows.name: glass-edge-glow
shadows.value: inset top gradient rgba(237,233,225,0.19) -> transparent over 40%
shadows.purpose: Lit top lip on frosted pills (inner highlight, not a drop shadow).

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: 90ms fade, no overshoot; haptics + state changes retained
motion.purpose: OS reduce-motion path for every SpringTap and the dock.

backdropFilter.name: glass-blur
backdropFilter.value: blur(18px) default, blur(22px) dock; never animated
backdropFilter.purpose: Frosted surfaces only — bounded to pills, icon buttons, the search field, the dock.

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Category filter. Uppercase mono; tap toggles, tapping the selected one (or ALL) clears.
components.css: .ds-chip { background: rgba(11,11,12,0.55); color: #EDE9E1; border: 1px solid rgba(237,233,225,0.14); border-radius: 2px; padding: 6px 12px; font-family: 'Martian Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.8px; text-transform: uppercase; transition: transform 0.09s; } .ds-chip:active { transform: scale(0.94); } .ds-chip--on { background: #FFA424; color: #0B0B0C; border-color: #FFA424; }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: Non-editable glass entry point; routes to the Search tab.
components.css: .ds-search { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; width: 100%; background: rgba(237,233,225,0.06); border: 1px solid rgba(237,233,225,0.14); border-radius: 16px; padding: 14px 16px; color: #9B988F; font-family: 'Martian Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.8px; text-transform: uppercase; backdrop-filter: blur(18px); }

components.name: Category Tag
components.description: Non-interactive information tag in the spotlight caption block.
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-block; background: rgba(11,11,12,0.55); color: #EDE9E1; border: 1px solid rgba(237,233,225,0.14); border-radius: 2px; padding: 6px 12px; font-family: 'Martian Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.8px; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Floating Glass Dock
components.description: The app's main navigation — a frosted pill floating over content. Gesture-driven: a horizontal pan drags the amber blob 1:1 with the finger (blob stretches toward travel direction by velocity, icons morph by proximity), and release spring-snaps to the nearest tab carrying fling velocity. Plain taps still select. Reduced motion: linear track, tween snap, no stretch.
components.css: .ds-dock { position: relative; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 8px 10px; border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(237,233,225,0.06); border: 1px solid rgba(237,233,225,0.14); backdrop-filter: blur(22px); box-shadow: 0 18px 40px -4px rgba(0,0,0,0.6), 0 3px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.25); touch-action: pan-x; } .ds-dock__blob { position: absolute; left: 12px; width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 22px; background: #FFA424; transition: none; } .ds-dock__i { position: relative; flex: 1; height: 44px; border: 0; background: transparent; color: rgba(237,233,225,0.72); font-size: 20px; } .ds-dock__i--on { color: #0B0B0C; transform: scale(1.07); }

components.name: Auth Sheet
components.description: Sign-in + OTP as a frosted bottom-sheet fragment over a blurred, dimmed backdrop of the caller's screen (never full-screen; no /login route). Email and OTP phases swap in place via slide+fade; the sheet grows/shrinks with AnimatedSize. Email: display heading, glass field, amber SEND CODE, OR rule, ghost 'Continue with Google'. OTP: back-arrow + CODE SENT TO {email}, centred letter-spaced code field, amber VERIFY, mono RESEND CODE.
components.html:
No password.
Just a code.

you@example.com
OR
components.css: .ds-authsheet { background: rgba(237,233,225,0.06); backdrop-filter: blur(22px); border: 1px solid rgba(237,233,225,0.14); border-radius: 20px 20px 0 0; padding: 12px 24px 24px; color: #EDE9E1; } .ds-authsheet__handle { display: block; width: 36px; height: 4px; margin: 0 auto 20px; border-radius: 2px; background: rgba(237,233,225,0.14); } .ds-authsheet__h { font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque', Georgia, serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 26px; line-height: 1.02; letter-spacing: -0.9px; margin: 0 0 16px; } .ds-authsheet__field { background: rgba(237,233,225,0.06); border: 1px solid rgba(237,233,225,0.14); border-radius: 12px; padding: 16px; color: #9B988F; font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque', Georgia, serif; } .ds-authsheet__or { text-align: center; margin: 12px 0; font-family: 'Martian Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 9.5px; letter-spacing: 1px; color: #9B988F; }

components.name: NsxButton
components.description: The one action button — a hard 2px-radius stamp, 52px tall, uppercase Martian Mono label, SpringTap press + haptic. Filled = amber / Cinema Black (primary). Ghost = glass-fill / hairline border / bone (secondary). One shape for both.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn ds-btn--fill">VERIFY</button><button class="ds-btn ds-btn--ghost">CONTINUE WITH GOOGLE</button>
components.css: .ds-btn { height: 52px; width: 100%; border-radius: 2px; font-family: 'Martian Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.8px; text-transform: uppercase; transition: transform 0.09s; } .ds-btn:active { transform: scale(0.94); } .ds-btn--fill { background: #FFA424; color: #0B0B0C; border: 1px solid #FFA424; } .ds-btn--ghost { background: rgba(237,233,225,0.06); color: #EDE9E1; border: 1px solid rgba(237,233,225,0.14); } .ds-btn:disabled { background: #201F1D; color: #9B988F; border-color: #2E2D2A; }

components.css: .ds-poster { display: block; width: 150px; } .ds-poster__img { aspect-ratio: 2/3; border: 1px solid #2E2D2A; border-radius: 4px; background: #161615; } .ds-poster__t { margin-top: 8px; font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque', Georgia, serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 15px; letter-spacing: -0.4px; color: #EDE9E1; } .ds-poster__m { margin-top: 4px; font-family: 'Martian Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 9.5px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 1px; text-transform: uppercase; color: #9B988F; } .ds-poster__v { margin-top: 2px; font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque', Georgia, serif; font-size: 12px; color: #9B988F; }

narrative.overview: NextShow's consumer surface is a repertory cinema's marquee after the lights drop: one monumental, printed title fills the field, and everything around it is precise typewriter signage. Near-monochrome — warm near-black ground, warm bone ink — lit by a single amber that behaves like a marquee bulb, marking only what is live or chosen. The register is confident and technical, not friendly; hierarchy comes from scale and material, never color variety. Frosted glass (genuine backdrop blur, crisp 1px edge, top inner-glow) is used only for floating interactive surfaces; hard-edged neo-brutalist tags (1px border, 2px radius, no shadow) carry fixed information. Imagery is never raw — every picture passes through duotone + film-grain + fine-linework so it reads as a pressed plate. Motion is physics, not decoration: tap targets punch down and spring back, and the spotlight arrives with one authored sequence.
keyCharacteristics: Warm near-black ground; one amber accent, live/selected state only.
Typographic extremes: monumental grotesque display against tight uppercase mono.
Frosted pills for interaction, hard 1px tags for information — never mixed.
Every image duotone + grain + linework; no raw photography.
Spring-physics feedback on every touch; one authored entrance per screen.

rules.name: The One Amber Rule
rules.body: The accent marks only what is live, selected, or current. If two things on screen are amber, one of them is wrong. Its rarity is the light.

rules.name: The Mono Signage Rule
rules.body: All metadata, labels, counts, and navigation text are uppercase Martian Mono. The display face never does label work; mono never does headline work.

rules.name: The Flat-Information Rule
rules.body: Anything that carries fixed information is flat with a 1px edge. Shadow is reserved for the one element that genuinely floats.

rules.name: The Hard Tag / Soft Pill Rule
rules.body: If it states information, it is a hard-edged rectangle. If it floats and responds to touch, it is a frosted pill. Never the reverse, never a blend.

rules.name: The Spring-Back Rule
rules.body: Every tap target punches to ~0.94 scale and springs back past 1.0 to rest — physics, never a linear ease. Under OS reduced-motion it collapses to a 90ms fade with no overshoot; haptics and state changes stay.

rules.name: The Continuous Track Rule
rules.body: A draggable indicator follows the finger in real time and resolves with a spring — never a stepped or instant jump. Movement is information: speed drives the deform (the dock blob's stretch), direction drives the icon morph.

rules.name: The No-Redirect Rule
rules.body: Identity is never a destination. Any flow that needs sign-in opens the auth sheet over the current screen; there are no /login routes and no full-screen OTP page.

dos: Do keep amber to one live/selected region per viewport (The One Amber Rule).
Do set every label, count, and metadata run in uppercase Martian Mono.
Do run every image through ProcessedImage — duotone + grain + linework.
Do use hard 1px-edge rectangles for information, frosted pills for touch.
Do give every tap target SpringTap feedback and a reduced-motion path.
Do let the OS text-size setting scale type; wrap, never clip.
Do open sign-in as the auth sheet over the current screen (The No-Redirect Rule); use one NsxButton shape for both variants.
Do make draggable indicators track the finger and resolve with a spring (The Continuous Track Rule).
donts: Don't introduce a second accent hue or a colored-category palette.
Don't ship a raw image, or fake the treatment with a low-opacity wash.
Don't use gradients as a surface fill (scrims over imagery are the only gradients allowed).
Don't add drop shadows to information surfaces; shadow is the floating dock's alone.
Don't use the display face for labels or the mono face for headlines.
Don't use Unicode glyphs or emoji as icons — draw them.
Don't route to a full-screen sign-in or OTP page.
Don't put a stepped or instant jump on a draggable indicator.

notCanonized: The wordmark's OverflowBox footprint clamp is an implementation workaround for the logo PNG's transparent padding, not a system rule.
The 'BERLIN · TONIGHT' location strip is a Discovery-surface element, not a global pattern.
cinema_theme.dart's Cinema* names are a back-compat shim for pre-redesign screens; new code imports NsxColors / NsxType directly.
